newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Barely steady European feeds start slow.
newsitem.headline: Barely steady European feeds start slow.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started slow this morning with selllers offering most products between unchanged and $2 lower on the back of a firmer dollar, market sources said.
Bids were scarce and no trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.

"The stronger dollar kept many buyers sidelined this morning. Also the barely changed seller prices were little incentive for operators to enter the market," one dealer said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
